_source: Roles paraphrased from https://opentelemetry.io/docs/demo/services/ and call relations from the service diagram at https://opentelemetry.io/docs/demo/architecture/ (read 20 Nov 2026). Only the services the query API lists in the minimal demo (no Kafka consumers, no AI assistant); the test harness's own services are hidden from the agent and left out. Nothing here comes from the scenario catalog.

ad.role: serves short text ads for the page a user is viewing

cart.role: stores and returns each user's shopping cart, kept in a key-value store

checkout.role: turns a cart into an order: reads the cart, converts prices, charges the payment, arranges shipping and sends the confirmation email

currency.role: converts money amounts between currencies; the busiest service by request rate

frontend.role: serves the web store's pages and its API

frontend-proxy.role: reverse proxy in front of the web store: routes requests to the frontend and the image provider

payment.role: charges a card for an order (a mock) and returns a transaction id

product-catalog.role: lists, searches and returns products from its data store

quote.role: computes a shipping cost from the number of items

recommendation.role: suggests other products based on what is in the cart

shipping.role: estimates shipping costs and ships orders (a mock)
